assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FINAL PRODUCTION BACKGROUND for a detailed painted Japanese fantasy 2D side-scrolling game. The attached concept sheet is explicitly user approved. Use ONLY its MIDDLE LEFT environment panel as the visual design reference, not its creatures or item icons. Create one standalone extra-wide panoramic background, 3:1 aspect, approximately 3072x1024, full opaque canvas. NO frame, panel divisions, labels, text, glyphs, UI, numbers, watermarks. Scene: a hidden ancient underground shrine cavern, deep jade-teal and grey rock, hanging stalactites, tangled pale roots, moss, weathered Japanese stone torii and rope with plain folded paper ornaments, warmly lit small stone lanterns, mist, a quiet jade pool and a slender distant waterfall, layered rock chambers receding into darkness. Rich painterly hand-painted textures, refined game illustration and crisp material details exactly matching approved concept and Kiba game art; not photoreal, not pixel art, not flat vectors. SIDE-VIEW game camera, not isometric or bird-eye. Completely empty of characters, serpents, animals, statues resembling enemies, cages, inventory items and combat effects. ACTUAL GAMEPLAY PLATFORMS AND COLLISION GEOMETRY WILL BE DRAWN SEPARATELY: do not paint floating stepping stones, jump stairs or obstacles across the foreground. The back of a clear level stone path may be IMPLIED consistently along horizontal y=76% image height (same height from left to right), with cool stone and reflections below, and the distant pool behind it. Keep broad open space immediately above that horizontal foot line for a large white serpent and small player to be drawn by the game. Main torii and lantern decorations stay toward far left/right and rear; no giant pillar obscuring the arena center. Bright grey/ivory and gold characters must contrast against the medium-dark teal cave behind them. No pure-black crushed details or harsh bright beam over the center. Entire scenery natural edge-to-edge with dark rock sides that can blend softly into surrounding underground Japanese landscape. Production environment ONLY; preserve the chosen visual direction without inventing a new character.
